zh.mc_connect_dialog_description: 选择连接方式后，核心侧一键写入，MC 侧复制到鹊桥配置文件即可。
zh.mc_connect_mode_recommend_note: 推荐：MC 服务器主动连接核心，MC 侧无需开放端口；核心地址已按当前访问地址自动生成。
zh.mc_connect_mode_forward_note: 核心主动连接 MC 服务器，需要 MC 侧开放监听端口，地址填 MC 服务器可被访问的 WebSocket 地址。
zh.mc_connect_written_hint: 已写入，重启机器人后生效
zh.mc_connect_core_desc_reverse: 将把鉴权令牌写入 .env（MINECRAFT_ACCESS_TOKEN），WS 地址保持为空。
zh.mc_connect_core_desc_forward: 将把该服务器的地址与令牌写入 .env（MINECRAFT_WS_URLS / MINECRAFT_ACCESS_TOKEN），已有其他服务器不受影响。
zh.mc_connect_server_block_title: MC 服务器侧 · 鹊桥（config.yml）
zh.mc_connect_code_comment_reverse: # 反向 WebSocket：MC 服务器主动连接核心
zh.mc_connect_code_comment_forward: # 正向 WebSocket：MC 服务器开放监听端口，等待核心接入

en.servers_broadcast_dialog_description: Send a broadcast message to all online servers
en.servers_broadcast_message_placeholder: e.g. The server will restart in 10 minutes
en.servers_empty_description: No Minecraft server has connected to the bot yet. Configure MINECRAFT_WS_URLS in the backend.
en.server_detail_terminal_empty: Type a command below and press Enter to run it
en.server_detail_permission_tip: Your current role cannot execute commands; operator or above required
en.mc_connect_dialog_description: Pick a connection mode, write the core side with one click, then copy the MC side into your QueQiao config file.
en.mc_connect_token_placeholder: Optional; leave empty to skip validation
en.mc_connect_mode_recommend_note: Recommended: the MC server connects to the core, so no inbound port is needed on the MC side; the core URL is generated from the address you are visiting.
en.mc_connect_mode_forward_note: The core connects to the MC server, which must open a listening port; enter a reachable WebSocket address of the MC server.
en.mc_connect_written_hint: Written; takes effect after restarting the bot
en.mc_connect_core_desc_reverse: Writes the access token to .env (MINECRAFT_ACCESS_TOKEN); the WS URL stays empty.
en.mc_connect_core_desc_forward: Writes this server's URL and token to .env (MINECRAFT_WS_URLS / MINECRAFT_ACCESS_TOKEN); other existing servers are unaffected.
en.mc_connect_code_comment_reverse: # Reverse WebSocket: the MC server connects to the core
en.mc_connect_code_comment_forward: # Forward WebSocket: the MC server opens a listening port and waits for the core
en.mc_connect_tip_plugin_config: The QueQiao plugin-side config lives at
en.mc_connect_docs_entry_description: MCDR plugin integration, header auth, Bedrock support and more
